author: Mark Atwood
text: WONTFIX 2026-05-12 (Mark, interactive on PKIX-apmt). Decision: abandon zlint mirroring as the source of pkix-lint-cabf catalog metadata. pkix-lint-cabf content will be hand-authored from CA/B Forum BR PDFs going forward. Rationale: (1) PKIX-apmt's wire-format decision deferred 7 days; mirroring would have required picking a format. (2) Smallest dependency surface wins for a 'reference, not authoritative' crate. (3) zlint+pkilint remain valuable as differential oracles (PKIX-hbzo.1) -- cross-validating hand-authored interpretations against the de facto reference catches divergence bugs that a shared-upstream model would hide. Trade-offs accepted: ongoing authorial burden; loses 'track upstream living rule set' benefit; pkix-lint-cabf-refresh/ dev sub-crate is now a no-op scaffold (left on disk pending separate decision). Decision-history shipped scaffolds .8.1 (zlint local install) and .8.2 (pkix-lint-cabf-refresh skeleton) remain closed. Children .8.3-.8.6 WONTFIX in this session.
